title: Whereas and Hereinafter
text:
Legal documents preserved archaic formulas long after ordinary speech had abandoned them. Words such as 'hereinafter', 'aforesaid' and 'whereas' were retained because their precision was valued more than their elegance, and a clerk who altered a traditional phrase risked introducing an ambiguity that a court might later exploit. The result is a register that sounds antiquated to laypeople yet remains functional for specialists.

Plain-language reformers have long argued that such language excludes citizens who cannot decode it. Their proposals typically replace archaic terms with shorter modern equivalents, but they must still guard against the loss of meaning that tradition has, over centuries, stabilised. The task, therefore, is not simply to modernise a document but to preserve its legal force while making it accessible to those it governs.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what were archaic formulas retained for?
What do plain-language reformers typically propose, according to the second paragraph?
options: Replacing archaic terms with shorter modern equivalents

questions.text: What does the passage imply about changing a traditional legal phrase?
options: It may introduce an ambiguity a court could later exploit

questions.text: Why must modernising a legal document be done with care?
options: Because tradition has stabilised meanings that could be lost
Because laypeople are forbidden to read contracts
Because modern words have no meaning

paragraph_translations: حفظت الوثائق القانونية صيغًا قديمة زمنًا طويلًا بعد أن تخلّت عنها اللغة اليومية. فقد بقيت كلمات مثل «hereinafter» و«aforesaid» و«whereas» لأن دقّتها كانت أثمن من أناقتها، وكان الكاتب الذي يغيّر عبارة تقليدية معرّضًا لإدخال غموض قد تستغله المحكمة لاحقًا. والنتيجة سجلٌّ لغوي يبدو عتيقًا للعامة لكنه يظل وظيفيًّا للمختصين.

ظلّ المصلحون الداعون إلى لغة واضحة يجادلون زمنًا طويلًا بأن هذه اللغة تُقصي المواطنين الذين لا يستطيعون فكّ شفرتها. وتقترح مقترحاتهم عادةً استبدال المصطلحات القديمة بمكافئات حديثة أقصر، لكن عليهم مع ذلك أن يحرسوا المعنى الذي ثبّتته التقاليد عبر القرون. فالمهمة إذن ليست تحديث الوثيقة فحسب، بل الحفاظ على قوتها القانونية مع جعلها سهلة الوصول لمن تحكمهم.
